sample_unit: chest CT scans (enriched; read by 6 physicians)
models_evaluated: AI-assisted decision-making software (DMS) for pulmonary nodules

links.outcome: Reader diagnostic performance (AUC) with versus without AI assistance
links.effect: Average AUC rose from 0.78 to 0.89 (mean difference 0.11, 95% CI 0.08, 0.14) with AI-assisted DMS; improvements consistent across experience levels and specialties.
links.quote: AI-assisted DMS significantly improved readers' diagnostic performance, with the average AUC increasing from 0.78 to 0.89 (mean difference: 0.11, 95% confidence interval [CI]: 0.08, 0.14).

unlisted_practices: Strengthening referral pathways for intermediate-risk pulmonary nodule cases in resource-limited settings

screen.reason: The study evaluates the diagnostic performance and inter-reader agreement of pulmonologists and radiologists reviewing chest CTs with versus without AI assistance in a multi-reader multi-case reader study.
